O.location: 2005 x-axis tick and leftmost plotted point
O.content: A black point aligned with the tick labeled '2005' has the adjacent inscription '$24.0°C'.

O.location: 2015 x-axis tick and rightmost plotted point
O.content: A black point aligned with the tick labeled '2015' has the adjacent inscription '$10.0°C'.
The blue connected line descends on the page from the 2005 point to the 2015 point.

B.text: If the plotted points are yearly temperature readings because their horizontal positions align with the year ticks and the adjacent °C inscriptions label those readings, then the 2005-to-2015 change is the 2015 reading minus the 2005 reading. If the substantial-trend workflow permits qualitative judgment of a large multi-year magnitude without a stated numeric cutoff, a 14.0°C decrease warrants follow-up.
B.conditions: Assumes the adjacent °C inscriptions apply to their points despite the visible leading '$' character, and assumes no unstated numeric threshold is required.
